entities.name: cfMethyl-Seq 408 QC-passing plasma samples
entities.description: Scoped author-reported evidence candidate; no clinical recommendation.

attributes.population: 217 cancers (49 colon, 30 liver, 106 lung, 32 stomach), 191 noncancers, from 479 generated libraries; 408 pass coverage >15x and conversion >98.7% QC. Of remaining 75% noncancer, 30 reserved solely for marker discovery. Fig 3c labels test n=102; per-split cancer/noncancer integer counts unreported.
attributes.assay: Plasma cfDNA methylome, cfMethyl-Seq, 150bp paired-end Illumina; UMI removal, Trim-galore, Bismark alignment to hg19/GRCh37 GCA000001405.1, Umi-Grinder deduplication
attributes.access: EGA EGAS00001006020; corresponding-author request; restricted to non-commercial entities
attributes.source_locator: XML Par16, Par34, Fig3 caption, Data availability

entities.name: cfMethyl-Seq stacked ensemble (2022)
entities.description: Scoped author-reported evidence candidate; no clinical recommendation.

attributes.model_version: Four L2 linear SVMs C=1 on marker count profiles, level-2 random forest 2000 trees; remaining scikit-learn defaults
attributes.access_reuse: Article CC-BY-4.0. Code https://github.com/jasminezhoulab/cfMethyl-Seq; article limits free use to educational/research by nonprofit institutions and US government; commercial uses contact author. No code licence inherited from article.

missing_metadata.checkpoint: No immutable serialized trained model identified

entities.name: cfMethyl-Seq random-split four-cancer detection
entities.description: Scoped author-reported evidence candidate; no clinical recommendation.

attributes.protocol: 10 random train/test splits, fit stacked classifier; mean held-out sensitivity at one false-positive noncancer sample (97.9% specificity); author-reported 95% CI across runs
attributes.control: 191 noncancer participants include noncancer diseases; not exclusively healthy controls. Individual marker models studied separately.
limitations: Random-split validation is not population screening or prospective clinical utility.
Separate independent WGBS validation cannot directly validate the level-2 random forest across platforms.

entities.name: HG002 GIAB v0.6 CNV deletion 1–5kb F-score
entities.description: Scoped author-reported evidence candidate; no clinical recommendation.

attributes.protocol: Compare copy-number calls to >1kb deletion records in GIAB SV v0.6; selected bin [1000,5000) bp.
attributes.control: CNVnator v0.4.1, default parameters on alignment BAM; Table S4 L6 .391, prose 39.20% conflicts. Conventional CNV-only DRAGEN row has F-score NaN, not zero.

missing_metadata.metric_implementation: Exact matching implementation for CNV endpoint unextracted; STR Truvari commands are not assigned to CNV

limitations: Deletion call concordance in one reference sample; no CNV duplications, clinical diagnosis, tumour ploidy or visualisation usability endpoint.
CNVnator comparator discrepancy prevents silently reconciling table and prose.

entities.name: HG002 DRAGEN full single-genome runtime on Phase4
entities.description: Scoped author-reported evidence candidate; no clinical recommendation.

attributes.protocol: Reported total pipeline runtime for the HG002 Phase4 row, Table S1 cell AE20. Use the reported total; do not sum separately reported stage durations. Stage concurrency is not established by this table.
attributes.control: Same sample on AWS f1.4xlarge, Xeon E5-2686v4 @2.30GHz, 16 threads, RAM (BG)251.0; total 5521.21 seconds at AE7. Hardware comparator, not another model.
limitations: Operational baseline for a conventional genomics pipeline; proxy to foundation-model execution workload.
One sample runtime is not cohort throughput, diagnostic report turnaround or demonstrated patient benefit.
Article separately reports ~2h joint aggregation over 3202 genomes at concurrency200, a different operation not assigned to this runtime.
